a: A text node that doesn't wrap is written with `autoLF` on, so P-touch wraps lines the canvas draws as one
RTL text under the default `direction: 'auto'`, or `style.direction: 'rtl'`, gets `start`/`end` mapped as if it were LTR
A run's `fontFeatures` (small caps drawn with the face's `smcp`) is dropped without notice
A polyline's `join` and `miterLimit` are ignored when it becomes a `draw:poly`
A rect stroke with `miterLimit` below √2 is written with square corners, but the canvas bevels them
`cap: 'square'` and `cap: 'butt'` both map to the same `SQUARE` arrow, so a square cap loses its overhang
`renderLabel` with `background: undefined` loses its white default
b: A text box aligned `start`/`end` is written LEFT/RIGHT whatever the resolved direction, so RTL text flips sides
A text box's `style.lineHeight` is dropped: multi-line text is written with P-touch's default line spacing
A text command with both `width` and `maxWidth` wraps at a different width in the file than on the canvas
A carrier under a mirrored rect clip is skipped although the clip is an axis-aligned rect
A stroked rect with `miterLimit` below √2 is written with sharp corners the canvas bevels
Raster content is cropped to the label's length while native objects past it are written whole
